excerpt: Download JackAI: Your offline assistant by D7 Labs on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like JackAI: Your offline…
content_html:
Your on-device AI assistant

Free · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Chat, understand photos, transcribe audio, and turn notes into next steps with AI that runs on your iPhone or iPad. Meet Jack AI, your on-device assistant for iPhone and iPad. Ask questions, work with text and photos, and turn recordings into useful notes. AI processing runs locally, keeping your prompts, conversations, photos, and recordings on your device. CHAT WITH LOCAL AI Download a supported model and start a conversation. Choose between models and adjust response settings to suit your task. On supported devices with Apple Intelligence enabled, you can also use Apple's on-device Foundation Model. MAKE SENSE OF YOUR PHOTOS Ask questions about a photo, extract visible text, or get a summary. Capture an image with the camera or choose one from your library. CAPTURE IDEAS IN YOUR OWN WORDS Dictate a draft, record and transcribe speech, or import an audio file. Review your transcript and use local AI to clean it up while preserving the original. TURN TEXT INTO ACTION Summarize notes, rewrite a passage, extract text from a document, or make an editable checklist. Review reminders and calendar events before saving them to your chosen destination. TRANSLATE AND CREATE Translate supported documents and transcripts using Apple's on-device translation. Generate QR codes locally, or download the optional image model to create images from a description. KEEP YOUR WORK CLOSE Conversations and saved files stay in local app storage. Export or share only when you choose. No account is required. Optional Google Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics help us understand app use and reliability when you enable them; AI content is excluded from these reports. See our privacy policy for details. BEFORE YOU START Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Downloadable models require an internet connection and available storage; some downloads are several gigabytes. Model speed and available features depend on your device, selected model, language, and system configuration. Apple Foundation Model use requires a compatible device with Apple Intelligence enabled and ready. Translation languages may require a separate system download. After the needed models are installed, supported AI tasks run on the device. AI can make mistakes. Review generated answers, transcripts, translations, and suggested actions before relying on them.
